press_references.value: OBIO® supports Trexo Robotics to Help Young Patients Walk at McMaster Children’s Hospital

product_launches.description: Trexo Robotics’ Trexo Plus pediatric robotic walking device has been newly adopted for use at Hamilton Health Sciences’ McMaster Children’s Hospital to support rehabilitation for children with mobility challenges.

overview_description.description:
Trexo Robotics is on a mission to redefine mobility solutions for all people. The company aims to create devices that are affordable, designed with the user in mind, and can be used at home. Fundamentally, Trexo is driven by the belief that people should have access to enabling technologies.

Currently, Trexo is building a device designed specifically for children with disabilities.
